title: Vídeo publicitario disruptivo — Legadia
prompt: Create a disruptive, high-budget, 10-second outdoor advertising film for a premium Spanish inheritance investigation company. A crowded glass bus shelter beside Madrid-Barajas Airport, aircraft and terminal architecture visible. Travellers with suitcases move quickly while camera performs a fast cinematic lateral tracking shot. Inside the shelter, a vertical digital billboard shows a confident Spanish man around 55 in an elegant dark-blue jacket. He comes alive, turns, establishes eye contact with one specific Spanish passerby around 50, leans forward and points at him while speaking in Spanish. The screen bends outward with spectacular anamorphic 3D advertising effect. Old family photos, inheritance documents, sealed envelopes and glowing golden genealogical lines burst into the real world. Brief dramatic slow motion as these remain suspended. One golden line travels through the crowd and connects to the selected man. Everyone else freezes. The selected man reacts with genuine astonishment. Finish with a rapid cinematic push-in on his face and return to the illuminated billboard. Final billboard exact text: USTED AÚN NO LO SABE. PERO LE ESTAMOS BUSCANDO. PUEDE TENER PARTE DE UNA HERENCIA. Final button exact text: DESCUBRA SU CASO AHORA. Audio: authentic Madrid airport ambience, distant aircraft, rolling suitcases, footsteps, subdued terminal announcements and crowd noise; deep cinematic impact when billboard comes alive; controlled whooshes, digital screen tension, glass vibration, flying paper sounds and rising cinematic effect during anamorphic explosion; brief silence when golden line connects; powerful elegant final advertising impact. Voice: native male from Madrid, Spain, age 50–55, Standard Castilian Spanish with natural Madrid accent, deep, confident and direct. Exact spoken sentence: Usted aún no lo sabe, pero le estamos buscando porque puede tener parte de una herencia. Descubra su caso ahora. Precise lip sync. Visual style: premium international advertising campaign, photorealistic Spanish people, strong cinematic contrast, electric blue and warm gold palette, realistic Madrid airport environment.
negative_prompt: No office, no lawyers, no meetings, no conventional corporate imagery, no fantasy, no horror, no comedy, no English voice, no Latin American accent, no robotic voice, no incorrect Spanish text, no distorted faces, no duplicated people, no deformed hands, no extra dialogue, no camera shake and no logos.

audio.spoken_text: Usted aún no lo sabe, pero le estamos buscando porque puede tener parte de una herencia. Descubra su caso ahora.

onscreen_text: PUEDE TENER PARTE DE UNA HERENCIA.
